name: Spirit Scourge
body:
School conjuration [pact]; Level antipaladin 3, cleric 3, inquisitor 3, paladin 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 10-ft. reach

Effect one scourge
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You create a crackling blackbarbed whip that you can use to suppress spirits. This whip strikes foes against their touch AC and on a successful hit, a foe must succeed on a Will save or have the granted abilities of the highest-leveled spirit that the target is bound to become suppressed for 1d4+1 rounds. This attack also deals damage as a whip appropriate for the caster’s size.
